function: Joint WD transmit and BS receive beamforming for over-the-air model aggregation (AirComp), plus SWIPT beamforming and power splitting, minimizing the FL convergence bound (p. 1, 3).
system: BS with M=2 antennas and K=10 devices with N=8 antennas each, no RIS; SWIPT downlink broadcast, AirComp uplink; 20 MHz bandwidth, carrier band not stated (p. 1, 4).
method: Federated learning of an MLP (one hidden layer, 200 neurons) across devices; radio design is non-learned: SCA and alternating optimization with MMSE receiver (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Channel matrices with path loss and small-scale fading, model unspecified (p. 2); learning data MNIST and FashionMNIST, K=10 devices, D_k=200 samples each (p. 4).
test_conditions: No separate test conditions stated: K=10 devices, 80 rounds (MNIST) and 120 (FashionMNIST) in Fig. 2; MSE swept over 10 to 25 devices in Fig. 3 (p. 4-5).
baselines: Noise-free AirFL (ideal bound), fixed beamforming, conventional AirFL [12] where devices cannot recharge (p. 4-5, Figs. 2-3).
metrics: Accuracy on MNIST and FashionMNIST versus rounds (Fig. 2, p. 4); aggregation MSE versus number of devices (Fig. 3, p. 5).
complexity: none for the AO/SCA design; only a qualitative remark (p. 4); FL model size Psi=159010 parameters (Table I) is not a cost of the method.
q1_support: p. 2: "which is composed of both path loss and small-scale" fading; the fading model is not specified. No 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured channel is used, and Table I (p. 4) lists no channel model.
q2_support: p. 5: "Fig. 3 shows that the MSE decreases with the number of" WDs; this only sweeps the number of devices (10 to 25). The letter reports no model trained in one condition and tested in another.
q3_support: p. 4: "we consider three benchmarks: 1) Noise-free AirFL 2) Fixed beamforming, and 3) Conventional AirFL"; p. 5 cites the third as "[12](WDs have limited energy and cannot replenish energy" (earlier published AirFL design); Figs. 2-3 compare accuracy and MSE.
q4_support: p. 4: "become more sophisticated as systems get larger, the threshold" can be adjusted: a qualitative remark only. No complexity order, operation count or runtime of the AO/SCA design is reported; Psi = 159010 (Table I) is the FL model size.
q5_support: p. 4: "based on the MNIST dataset or FashionMNIST dataset" for the learning task only, which does not count. Channels come from the authors' own simulation; no code or data link is given.
notes: Included, area 7: AirFL with AirComp aggregation; the learned element is the MLP trained across the devices, while the radio design is classical optimization (SCA, AO), so no_learning does not apply (p. 3-4). M=2, N=8 and the other values come from Table I, read from the page image (p. 4). q3 is borderline: the conventional AirFL benchmark is only cited as [12] (p. 5) with no description of its design, and fixed beamforming is the authors' own heuristic.
